items: ✦Elegant Design with Premium Details--Forget uncomfortable "dressy" tops! Ours feels as soft and stretchy as your favorite tee, but the beautiful V-neck and delicate petal sleeves with lace details make it look polished and put-together. You'll feel effortlessly chic from the moment you put it on.

✦Flatters Your Body — No Guesswork--The V-neck is universally slimming, and the clever cut of the petal sleeves gracefully skims your arms. Designed with real women's bodies in mind, it offers a fit that's both forgiving and feminine, making you look and feel your best.

items.label: ✦Versatile Wear
items.value: From Office to Vacation--Dress it up for work with slacks, wear it with jeans for school drop-off, or pair it with a skirt for a weekend brunch. We even offer prints perfect for your next vacation. This is the one top that does it all, saving you time and stress in the morning.

items: ✦Easy-Care Fabrics for Your Busy Life--Both our solid and print tops are made from easy-care, machine-washable fabrics that hold their shape and color wash after wash. Toss it in the laundry—it's made to last.

items.label: ✦Find Your Vibe
items.value: Classic Solids or Fun Prints--Love a timeless, classy look? Choose our solid colors with elegant lace sleeves. Want to express your fun side? Pick from our collection of stylish prints. Check WIHOLL size chart to find your perfect fit—we're here to help if you need us!
